options.name: Now
options.line: Today the guitar lifts off its plinth and the camera goes straight to the first stops.

options.name: Ink on Paper
options.line: The room turns to a cream sheet, the plan is inked with its numbers, stands up into section lines, and the finish spreads out from the bridge.

options.name: Contour Stack
options.line: The plan's height lines peel off the sheet into a stack of slices, and the solid guitar grows up through them.

options.name: Lights Down
options.line: No sheet. The plan is drawn in light where the guitar stood, turns in the dark, and the guitar comes back from the tail up.
